name: editor_state
description: s&box editor context: project, active/open scenes, selection, Hammer map, visible Qt windows, focus and tutorial.

name: scene_tree
description: Edited scene hierarchy: object IDs, names, components and optionally serialized component properties. Separate from native UI and Hammer brush geometry.

root.description: Scene root, GameObject GUID or exact name.

name: ui_snapshot
description: Structured live native Qt widgets, tree/list/table items, tabs, menus and QGraphicsItems, with rectangles/state/locators. Custom GPU canvases expose the viewport, not arbitrary drawn objects.

root.description: Live eN ref, persistent /qt/ locator from ui_describe, or an unambiguous query {text,class,name,kind,under,label,visible_only}. Rectangles are screen coordinates in Qt logical pixels; input x/y are window client coordinates. Locators follow native widget ancestry and sibling ordinals; re-discover after a layout redesign. A missing parent scope never falls back to global search; Qt base-class names are supported.

name: ui_find
description: Native Qt widgets/virtual items. Filters combine. Text/class/tooltip use case insensitive substrings; exact is case sensitive. Narrow ambiguous targets to a ref or locator.

class.description: Qt metaobject class name substring, e.g. Button, QLineEdit or CQHammer.

under.description: Live eN ref, persistent /qt/ locator from ui_describe, or an unambiguous query {text,class,name,kind,under,label,visible_only}. Rectangles are screen coordinates in Qt logical pixels; input x/y are window client coordinates. Locators follow native widget ancestry and sibling ordinals; re-discover after a layout redesign. A missing parent scope never falls back to global search; Qt base-class names are supported.

label.description: Semantic child QLabel text identifying a native form row, e.g. class=CQTextureControl,label=Color. Supports stable field lookup without positional widget paths.

name: ui_describe
description: Persistent locator, window, rectangle, visibility and hidden reasons (inactive tab, collapsed parent, clipping, hidden ancestor, modal blocker).

target.description: Live eN ref, persistent /qt/ locator from ui_describe, or an unambiguous query {text,class,name,kind,under,label,visible_only}. Rectangles are screen coordinates in Qt logical pixels; input x/y are window client coordinates. Locators follow native widget ancestry and sibling ordinals; re-discover after a layout redesign. A missing parent scope never falls back to global search; Qt base-class names are supported.

name: ui_act
description: Deliver native Qt mouse/key events without moving the OS cursor. Reports queued/delivering/completed/failed delivery. Event delivery does not prove an application-level change.

target.description: Live eN ref, persistent /qt/ locator from ui_describe, or an unambiguous query {text,class,name,kind,under,label,visible_only}. Rectangles are screen coordinates in Qt logical pixels; input x/y are window client coordinates. Locators follow native widget ancestry and sibling ordinals; re-discover after a layout redesign. A missing parent scope never falls back to global search; Qt base-class names are supported.

x.description: Canvas x in the window (instead of target).

window.description: Window ref/locator for x,y or key (default: main or target's window).

text.description: type inserts Unicode text; paste replaces text through clipboard Ctrl+A/Ctrl+V.

amount.description: For scroll: wheel steps, positive = down.

show.description: Highlight 350 ms before delivery; mark lasts about 1 second.

name: ui_highlight
description: Show highlight boxes (numbered when several) on elements, with an optional callout text. Non-blocking: the user can keep working. Use for 'where is X?' questions.

items.description: Live eN ref, persistent /qt/ locator from ui_describe, or an unambiguous query {text,class,name,kind,under,label,visible_only}. Rectangles are screen coordinates in Qt logical pixels; input x/y are window client coordinates. Locators follow native widget ancestry and sibling ordinals; re-discover after a layout redesign. A missing parent scope never falls back to global search; Qt base-class names are supported.

clear.description: Remove existing highlights first (or only, if no targets).

name: ui_guide
description: Interactive numbered highlights, instruction bubble, dim spotlight, live targets, auto-scroll and conditions. Agent clicks do not satisfy human-click steps.

target.description: Live eN ref, persistent /qt/ locator from ui_describe, or an unambiguous query {text,class,name,kind,under,label,nth,visible_only}. Use nth for the zero-based position among siblings of the same concrete class and object name. A missing parent scope never falls back to global search; Qt base-class names are supported.

text.description: Short instruction shown in the callout.

restrict_clicks.description: Override the guide's mouse click restriction for this step.

skip_if.description: Skip this step without clicking its target when this UI condition holds, such as an already visible panel.

confirm_on_return.description: Require manual confirmation when returning to this step. Set false to evaluate its completion condition again.

target_when_disabled.description: Alternate control to highlight while the primary control is disabled.

allow.description: Additional mouse targets for a restricted step. Control queries also allow their child widgets.

until.description: click (default), manual, or {any:[conditions]}, {all:[conditions]}, {not:condition}, {exists:target}, {visible:target}, {enabled:target}, {text_contains:{target,text}}, {text_equals:{target,text,committed:true}}, {number_equals:{target,value,committed:true}}, {tooltip_contains:{target,text}}, {key:"Ctrl+S"}, {selected:"GUID|name"}, {inspecting:"GUID|name"}, {main_screen:"scene name|Hammer"}, {context:{path:"hammer.selection_mode",equals:"Faces"}}, {file_saved:{path:"Assets/example.vmat",ext:"vmat",contains:"text"}}. Initially satisfied completion conditions normally require confirmation. File checks are bounded and throttled.

action.description: ui_act action string or full argument object for do_step.

fallback.description: Godot-style fallback query used when the recorded target locator no longer resolves. Must identify the same control unambiguously.

project_path.description: Project-relative file path. On entry its absolute path in the current viewer project is copied to the clipboard; do_step paste resolves it at runtime. Never store the author computer path in a shared tutorial.

dim.description: Dim everything except the current target.

restrict_clicks.description: Allow mouse clicks only on the current target, step allow rules, guide navigation and blocking dialogs.

activate_window.description: Present the correct target window once on tutorial start/step transition or when a missing window appears. Does not repeatedly take focus on timer ticks.

open_assets.description: Optional prerequisite project resource paths, e.g. maps/practice.vmap. Opened read-only through the editor after capturing the rollback checkpoint; no asset contents are changed.

name: guide_status
description: Tutorial state, index/count, target waiting and bounded click/key/transition log.

name: guide_control
description: next/prev/stop, restart (rollback by default), or demonstrate do_step. Rollback reports its actual scope and omissions.

rollback.description: restart only: first roll the editor back to how it was when the guide started (same rollback as rehearsals).

name: editor_screenshot
description: Native window PNG with overlay. target crops, window selects a whole window. Returns PNG and local path. Requires interactive desktop; GPU viewport capture may need a visible window.

target.description: Live eN ref, persistent /qt/ locator from ui_describe, or an unambiguous query {text,class,name,kind,under,label,visible_only}. Rectangles are screen coordinates in Qt logical pixels; input x/y are window client coordinates. Locators follow native widget ancestry and sibling ordinals; re-discover after a layout redesign. A missing parent scope never falls back to global search; Qt base-class names are supported.

name: editor_exec
description: Trusted async C# method body on the editor UI thread. Globals Root/Tree, Node(nameOrGuid), FindAll<T>(), cancellationToken. Return a value. Use UndoScope for mutations; no GDScript/Godot API emulation.

name: rehearsal_start
description: Record ui_act with persistent locators; checkpoint scene undo/selection/tabs/windows, bounded project file backups and active Hammer objects. Arbitrary human/editor_exec input is not recorded.

name: rehearsal_stop
description: Convert actions to guide/recipe, optionally play, restore checkpoint by default. Restores scene undo/selection/active tab, closes new tabs/windows, restores backed-up files and active Hammer objects. Reports closed documents, settings/native history, skipped large files and mutations without undo. Hammer snapshots cannot reconstruct deleted original nodes; use native Undo for those. Inspect rollback.complete and rollback.warnings.

texts.description: Instruction text per generated step, in order (empty string keeps the default). Write them in the user's language.

save_as.description: Project tutorial name to save under Config/AIGuide/Recipes/.

name: recipe_list
description: List saved recipes (rehearsed procedures) in this project.

name: recipe_play
description: Start the guide for a saved recipe.

activate_window.description: Present the correct target window once on tutorial start/step transition or when a missing window appears. Does not repeatedly take focus on timer ticks.

name: ai_guide_reload
description: Clear overlays and restart plugin services next frame. C# hotloads via s&box; native DLL updates require editor restart. No engine rebuild.
